Through `auto`, tokens arrive progressively on each engine (llama.cpp, MLX, Ollama) — the stream decision now follows the answer's content type (Task 2). Through `auto`, tokens arrive progressively on each engine (llama.cpp, MLX, Ollama) — the stream decision now follows the answer's content type (Task 2). Ollama.app started by hand → the offer appears in advanced mode, "Use Ollama" switches (Task 4). Kill the engine mid-answer → the Log shows "Interrupted" with the engine's error (Task 1). Simple mode Models page: no engine names, no tok/s, VoiceOver does not stop on an empty line (Task 5).

Through `auto`, tokens arrive progressively on each engine (llama.cpp, MLX, Ollama) — the stream decision now follows the answer's content type (Task 2). Ollama.app started by hand → the offer appears in advanced mode, "Use Ollama" switches (Task 4). Kill the engine mid-answer → the Log shows "Interrupted" with the engine's error (Task 1). Simple mode Models page: no engine names, no tok/s, VoiceOver does not stop on an empty line (Task 5).

Through `auto`, tokens arrive progressively on each engine (llama.cpp, MLX, Ollama) — the stream decision now follows the answer's content type (Task 2). Ollama.app started by hand → the offer appears in advanced mode, "Use Ollama" switches (Task 4). Kill the engine mid-answer → the Log shows "Interrupted" with the engine's error (Task 1). Simple mode Models page: no engine names, no tok/s, VoiceOver does not stop on an empty line (Task 5).

Through `auto`, tokens arrive progressively on each engine (llama.cpp, MLX, Ollama) — the stream decision now follows the answer's content type (Task 2). Simple mode Models page: no engine names, no tok/s, VoiceOver does not stop on an empty line (Task 5).

Through `auto`, tokens arrive progressively on each engine (llama.cpp, MLX, Ollama) — the stream decision now follows the answer's content type (Task 2).
